bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 116 (Thursday, July 16, 2026)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mrs. McBATH:
H.R. 9754.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, clause 18, provides Congress with the
power to ``make all Laws which shall be necessary and proper
for carrying into Execution'' the powers enumerated in
Article I and ``all other Powers vested by [the] Conititution
in the Government of the United States, or in any Department
or Officer thereof.''
[Page H4624]
